messages:
hani_support: Escalating to CS: Vertexly (trial) reporting intermittent 500s and throttling on embeddings during a large ingest. Customer says this blocks their integration tests and demo. Marked P1.

hani_support: Repro: sync upload ~4.2k docs, errors start ~1min in. Sample: `HTTP 500 {\"error\":\"internal_server_error\"}` and `HTTP 429 {\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\", \"retry_after\":30}`. No deploys since yesterday.

emma_cs: Thanks Hani. Contact is maya@vertexly.io; trial ends 2026-09-10. We should offer a temporary quota uplift and a quick bridge. Please draft customer wording.

hani_support: Logs show gateway token exhaustion and router backpressure: `[2026-08-30T14:02:11Z] limiter INFO tenant=vertexly tokens=exhausted` and `[2026-08-30T14:02:12Z] router ERROR OOM allocating KV cache`. Client retried aggressively which amplified the problem.

carmen_eng: Looks like KV-cache churn + gateway throttling under retry storms. Quick mitigations: 1) advise async batch + reduce concurrency to 2, 2) temporary tenant_quota bump for 24h, 3) consider small prod canary for `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8`. I can run an audit and staging repro. ETA 3h for audit, 8-12h for canary.

ops-bot: autoscaler: recommending manual headroom +25% for embed pool during mitigation. Will page if error rate >5% sustained.

liam_csm: Proposal for customer note: "Hi Maya — were investigating intermittent errors during your import. Short-term: please switch to the async batch endpoint and set concurrency=2; we can apply a one-time quota increase while we investigate. Engineering will provide an update within 4 hours and an RCA within 48 hours. We can also run the remaining import for you if you prefer." Approve?

emma_cs: Approve. Add CLI example and offer of concierge run. I'll schedule a 20-min bridge in the next hour.

hani_support: CLI example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d @batch.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" --concurrency 2` and recommended backoff.

carmen_eng: Running tenant quota audit now. If trial default quota is low we can bump vertexly to 300 req/min for 24h. I'll post results in 45m.

ops-bot: action: holding manual headroom request pending eng audit.

h ani_support: (typo) correction: Hani will send immediate note to customer once bridge time confirmed.

liam_csm: I'll log renewal-risk flag and prepare offer for one-week trial extension if they request it. Keep updates short for exec summary.

carmen_eng: Audit complete: trial quota was 90 req/min. Applying tenant_quota=320 for 24h now and starting staging repro.

ops-bot: action: tenant_quota=320 applied to tenant=vertexly at 2026-08-30T14:30Z (24h). Manual headroom +25% applied.

hani_support: Update: after quota bump and switching to async + concurrency=2 the customer completed 78% of their import and paused retries. They want the RCA before the demo.

emma_cs: Scheduled bridge with Maya for 2026-08-30 16:00 PT and invited @carmen_eng and @hani_support. I'll send the pre-brief and runbook now.

carmen_eng: Staging repro confirms KV-cache eviction under heavy parallel prefixes. `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8` reduced OOMs by ~85% in tests. Preparing small prod canary and RCA draft.

liam_csm: Thanks team. After RCA please include suggested long-term changes (trial quota defaults, onboarding guardrails, telemetry for retry storms) so I can attach to the renewal playbook. Keep thread concise.

hani_support: Will post final timeline + logs after prod canary completes.

emma_cs: Customer appreciative of fast response; promised to wait for the RCA before finalizing their demo. I'll follow up post-canary.
